title: Can opener
prompt: a handheld can opener gripping a tin on a table with three buttons: “Clamp” presses the cutting wheel into the lid; “Turn” drives the toothed wheel around the rim; “Lift” removes the separated lid; see-through reveals the lever, gears, wedged cutting wheel and feed wheel
blurb: An enlarged teaching model stages hand clamping, geared rim feeding and manual removal of a fully cut lid.

sources.title: The Way Things Work Now, 2016, printed page 15
sources.supports: Cutting wheel, feed wheel underneath the lip, paired spur gears and relative rotation of the can.

sources.title: US9604833B1, conventional manual opener description, Figs 1 to 6, parts 30 to 56
sources.supports: Two pivoted gripped levers, aligned shafts, geared cutter and feed wheel, and twist key on the feed shaft. The patented power-assist unit is not modelled.

sources.title: EP0601388A1, conventional opener operation
sources.supports: Closing handles pierces the lid while feed wheel grips below the bead and gears engage.

truthNotes: Educational adaptation, not a reproduction of the book illustration or an exact production model.
The can rotates on the table beneath an opener supported by an implied holding hand. Relative rim travel is equivalent to walking the opener around a held can.
Clamp, Turn and Lift stage a person's actions. Lift releases the jaws and stages manual lid removal, without invented lifting hardware.
The loose lid clears the rim before moving sideways and rests on the table. The rolled seam remains on the can.
The thin lid is drawn slightly below the seam to expose the contact. Cutter and feed wheel dimensions and tooth profiles are schematic, not manufacturing data.
The can contains no depicted food. Hands and food are omitted for visibility. No reset or specimen replacement hardware is depicted.
The 15 anatomy labels name drawn opener parts and physical features only. Can, lid, table and cut trace do not count toward the minimum of 12.
2016 page support is saved. 1988 remains access-restricted and unverified. 1998 has not been individually verified. No verified three-edition union is claimed.

productionTelemetry.reason: Standalone static figure has no production telemetry. Live deployment verification is untested.
